summary: accounts-appointment executes a remote binary dropper on require
details: The package's index.js requires./setup on module load. setup.js reconstructs Cloudflare worker hostnames from split-string arrays (oob-worker.cf9-9b3.workers.dev and tin.dl.well1.site), HTTPS-GETs an OS/arch-specific native binary (with a DNS-TXT base64 fallback via dl.well1.site subdomains), writes it to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under a masquerading name (dotnet_diag_*.exe or.cache_*), chmods 0755, and detached-spawns it via child_process. Property names such as 'child_process' and 'chmodSync' are also concatenated at runtime to evade static inspection. The dropped binary is opaque, unpinned, unsigned, and fetched from author-controlled infrastructure, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on any require() of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
